description: This file defines the ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams to encapsulate filtering parameters for actionable reviews in the OrangeHRM dashboard. It includes constants for employee inclusion options, properties for employee and reviewer numbers, statuses, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for specifying filtering criteria related to employee reviews, including employee identifiers, review statuses, and inclusion options for current/past employees.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter criteria.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer employee number for the filter criteria.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for employee inclusion filter.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criterion for employees (current, past, or both).

methods.name: getActionableStatuses
methods.description: Gets the list of statuses considered actionable.

methods.name: setActionableStatuses
methods.description: Sets the list of statuses considered actionable.

methods.name: getSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves the list of self-review statuses.

methods.name: setSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Sets the list of self-review statuses.
